RESOLUTION.DESC:
The Security Council,
Turning its attention to the shimmering legacy of [region]the New Meritocracy[/region], which, having originated in [region]Meritocratic Isles[/region] soon after the inception of the universe, inspired antiquity with the velocity and significance of its rise,
Forgiving at last the New Meritocracy for its measured opposition to the World Assembly’s predecessor, a stance born not out of childish resentment and impudence, but instead of a desire to protect itself from the invasions that august body enabled, and the regrettable intolerance it has harbored towards national sovereignty,
Careful to note the Meritocracy’s tenacity in enduring many early stressors and collapses that would contextualize its later success, of which include: [list][*]The disappearance of its founder, [nation]Thomasia[/nation], from the birthplace of the New Meritocracy, Meritocratic Isles, resulting in a power struggle and an eventual brave migration to a new home, [region]New Meritocracy[/region], [*]The betrayal of New Meritocracy’s trusted delegate, [nation]Old Carthage[/nation], provoking a second and final migration to the New Meritocracy and the complete repudiation of membership in the World Assembly’s predecessor, [*]The bitter “pebbles” civil war and mass exodus of prominent senators to a competing meritocratic Confederacy, which ended the Charter system in the New Meritocracy and resulted in its eventual replacement with the Accords Senate,[/list] Wondering how, despite the chaos and struggle of its early history, the New Meritocracy still could survive to give birth to the legendary Meritocratic Senate, a historic proving grounds wherein representatives from nations as diverse as [nation]Unistrut[/nation], [nation]Pierconium[/nation], [nation]Winnipeg[/nation], and [nation]Blackbird[/nation], and organizations as diverse as the New Pacific Order and the Alliance Defense Network, met to don the cloaks of senators, debate, legislate, and serve under a singular banner,
Impressed by the trailblazing efforts made within the New Meritocracy by nations such as Winnipeg at establishing foundational regional tools and infrastructure, including a regional map, a private communications center, once hailed as revolutionary by the Goddess Violet, and the highly prolific and broad Meritocratic Times,
Fascinated by the operations of the Globally Unified Statistics and Trade Organization (GUSTO), an establishment directed by members of the New Meritocracy and dedicated to the management of central banks, and calculation of economic figures involving worker productivity, wealth distribution, interest rates, gross domestic product, trade deficits, and more,
Dutifully acknowledging the diligent effort undertaken by the nations of the New Meritocracy in chronicling the many rich and vibrant stories of the region’s multiyear history, in ambitious ventures such as the Encyclopaedia Meritocratica and its successor, the Herodotus Project,
Thankful towards the New Meritocracy for serving as haven for mature dialogue and debate amongst the political right, as exemplified by its tolerance of and openness towards leftwing perspectives amongst its members, and its use of interregional events like the World Capitalist Summit and concomitant political dialogue to sway minds and facilitate cooperation,
Particularly impressed by the Meritocracy’s commitment to establishing the Alliance of Capitalists, Conservatives, and Economic Libertarians (ACCEL), a future co-creator of the widely well-regarded COPS agreement, and among the most successful conservative organizations in history, as a means of unifying like-minded regions under a singular banner, and stamping out the once common practice of invading leftwing regions solely on the basis of a political disagreement,
Relieved that the New Meritocracy could relax its instinct for neutrality to take a stand against the forces of evil in the world, as evidenced by its decision to condemn the practice of invading other regions within its Charter, its decision to admit [region]The Sardaukar Confederacy[/region], a defender region, into its prefecture network, and its occasional impulse to rally to the defense of other regions, such as [region]Feudal Japan[/region],
Respecting the New Meritocracy’s sincere attempt at reforming the Atlantic Alliance, a feared imperialist organization, by invading its base of operations, placing the New Meritocracy’s founder, Thomasia, in control over its ranks, and establishing the Allied Liberation League to guide it, even if this attempt did not ultimately succeed,
Emphasizing the significance of the Meritocratic Senate’s characteristic exclusivity in attracting the sheer diversity of talent necessary for it to become the legendary political hub for which it is unlikely to ever be fully forgotten,
Hereby commends The New Meritocracy.
RESOLUTION.NAME: Commend The New Meritocracy
